description: Suijin OS v5.3.0 — the field-hardened release. Red side: engagement console UI rebuilt from live runs (iteration panels with markdown, fast thinking spinner, uncrashable renderer with crash logs, termination banners for every ending, instant Ctrl+C, 15-command pause console), operator authorization workflow (suijin authorize ledger + advisory bb-scope + program-page fetch with the Cloudflare-exists doctrine), supervisor as battle-buddy (52 tactical heuristics, cooldowns, de-interfered detectors), accurate per-model token pricing, provider-flake auto-restart, JS-bundle mining tools, and a reinstall-durable workspace at ~/.suijin/workspace. 1,558 tests green.
